ability.bending.fire_blast.desc: A quick fire punch, alternating hands. Two hits take down most mobs.
ability.bending.fire_jet_dash.desc: An explosive burst launches you the way you're pressing, tilted by your aim. Keep holding Ctrl to ride the jets and steer.
ability.bending.meteor_slam.desc: Dive like a meteor where you look and hit in a ring of fire. The higher you start, the harder it hits; from above dash height it explodes.
ability.bending.fire_arc.desc: A spinning kick sends out a wide crescent of fire that sweeps 12 blocks forward, burning everything it passes through.
ability.bending.fire_shield.desc: Hold: a disc of flame that burns up projectiles and scorches attackers. Tap: Flame Burst, a ring of fire that knocks everything back.
ability.bending.flame_parry.desc: A split-second block. Anything that hits you from the front in that window is burned back, and you regain chi.
ability.bending.jet_propulsion.desc: Sustained flight on fire jets. Fly where you look; sneak to hover. Drains chi fast.
ability.bending.firestorm.desc: Gather fire for a second, then erupt: a cratering blast, a ring of explosions and a flaming vortex.
ability.bending.combustion_beam.desc: Focus fire into one point, then fire an instant explosive beam. More charge means more damage and a bigger blast.
ability.bending.lightning.desc: Charge with a calm mind, then strike with a bolt that chains to nearby enemies, or to everything in rain or water. Getting hit while charging backfires.
